allowPermissionsDesc: Ni a bɛ baarakɛ, MCP baarakɛcogow bɛ ka sɔn cogoya kelen na k'a sɔrɔ u tɛ yamaruya diyalogiw jira. Nin cogoya in bɛ waleya ka ɲɛsin kumaɲɔgɔnyaw bɛ ma, ka kumaɲɔgɔnya kuraw fara a kan.

runtimeSettings.title: Runtime Settings
runtimeSettings.description: Novera be MCP ka baarakɛlaw mara ani k’u lajɛ tugun cogo min na, o labɛn.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeout: Ka baarakɛ minɛnw wele waati laban (sekondi)
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Wati min ka can ka MCP minɛnw jaabi di sani ka waati laban.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Jaabi min ka jan ni baarakɛcogo ye min maralen do kumaɲɔgɔnya kɔnɔ. O kɔfɛ, fɛn o fɛn bɛ bɔ ni a bɛ mara i n'a fɔ a ka surunyalen, o la jaabi ba dɔ tɛ se ka model ka kokɔrɔbɔ laben. Jabi kɛ ka kɛ 0 ye ka jaabi marali dafalen.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRouting: Smart MCP ka baarakɛ minɛnw sira
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: Ni a bɛ baarakɛ, Novera bɛ MCP baarakɛlaw sugandi sani ka baarakɛcogow dabɔ. Ka dabali kɛ ka MCP baarakɛcogow ka lisi dabɔ tuma bɛɛ.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModel: Ka baara kɛ ni suguya dɔ ye ka sira di
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: Ni smart routing bɛ labaara, ka routing dakun waleya ni suguya wɛrɛ ye (a ka c'a la fitini) ka tɛmɛ kunnafolifalen suguya kan. K'a bila k'a labaara tuma bɛɛ ni kunnafolifalen suguya ye min bɛ baara kɛ walasa ka kunnafolifalen kɛ.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: A ka kan ka baarakɛla ni suguya dɔ sugandi yɔrɔ kelen na. A ka kan ka kɛ a ye suguya fitiniw dɔrɔn de jira o la. O la, sira ɲɛnamaya bɛ se ka kɛ teliman ani nɔgɔn ye.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: Model fitini tɛ sɔrɔ. Ka fara model fitini kan walima ka API keyw labɛn Models kɔnɔ.
